votes.motion: Commissioner McElreath – I move that we send a negative recommendation to the City Council for File #1G21 to amend the proposed Land Use Map in the General Plan for the property at 1758 West 5400 South (Parcel 21-10-379-034-0000) from “Regional Commercial” to “High-Density Mixed-Use.” Based on the findings outlined in the Staff Report and discussion this evening

Commissioner Quigley – I move that we send a positive recommendation to the City Council for File #2Z21 to amend the Zoning Map for the property at 1633 West 6235 South (Parcel #21-22-202- 065-0000) from Residential (R-1-10) to Professional Office (PO), based on the Findings as outlined by Staff previously

Commissioner Russell - I move to send a recommendation of approval to the Taylorsville City Council to amend the Taylorsville General Plan for property located at 3815-3879 West 5400 South from Regional Commercial to High Density Mixed Use based on the Findings of Fact stated in the Staff Report for File 4G21. It is further recommended that should the specific project that this amendment is intended to facilitate fail to materialize, that the General Plan designation revert back to Regional Commercial

Commissioner Quigley - I move to send a recommendation of approval to the Taylorsville City Council adopting the proposed Site-Specific Development – Mixed Use – West Point zoning designation based on the Findings of Fact stated in the Staff Report for File #6Z21

Commissioner Wright - I move to send a recommendation of approval to the Taylorsville City Council to rezone the property located at 3815-3879 West 5400 South from Regional Commercial to Site Specific Development – Mixed Use – West Point, based on the Findings of Fact stated in the Staff Report for File #10Z21. It is further recommended that should the specific project that this amendment is intended to facilitate fail to materialize, that the zoning designation revert back to Regional Commercial

Commissioner Quigley – I move that we send a positive recommendation to the City Council for File #4Z21 for an amendment to the Land Development Code related to shared driveways, as specified in Exhibit B based on the Findings outlined in the Staff Report

Commissioner McElreath – I move that we send a positive recommendation to the City Council for File #8Z21 for an amendment to the Land Development Code related to drive-through facilities, as specified in Exhibit A, based on the Findings outlined in the Staff Report
By motion the meeting was adjourned.
